name: Docuseal
description: Open source document signing platform for creating, sending, and tracking e-signature requests.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://docuseal:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/docuseal"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      SECRET_KEY_BASE: {{env.SECRET_KEY_BASE}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: docuseal
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: docuseal
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
